versions.changelog:
Initial release of thesis-tracker skill:

- Enables tracking and validation of investment theses based on user prompts.
- Extracts thesis structure (title, assumptions, triggers, time window, targets) from user input.
- Stores and manages thesis data in a JSON index (`theses.json`).
- Supports regular automated checking and status updates for all pending theses.
- Summarizes progress and status in clear, concise reports.
- Integrates with IMA for thesis note synchronization.
